_notes.h1: hash of the trunk held by the evaluating process; on the DB6 CPU rows this is the hash of the CPU copy of the weights (the GPU model is not touched), so it cannot detect a change of the GPU trunk.
_notes.h2: backprop_steps is a constant 0 written by the eval script plus the no_grad guard; it is a code-path property, not a measurement.
_notes.h4: only checks that the number of calibration trials equals B (len(cal_trials) == B); the unit test (non-calibration trials replaced by noise give bit-identical stats) is the real content check.
_notes.h5: covers the output table only (K x N fp16 <= 32 KB). The descriptor accumulators (Gram etc.) are NOT included: they exceed 32 KB for Hyser (N=256) and fit for DB6 (N=14) only without any per-trial copy; see cost_model.json. H5 is therefore NOT satisfied for the whole calibration path on Hyser.
_notes.accumulator_simulation: accumulators were simulated in float64; fp32 per-bin streaming was checked by the reviewer (rel err ~2e-7, |dR2| <= 1e-4); fixed-point per-add rounding/saturation was NOT simulated (feasibility rule 8 open item).
